analysis.narrativeEn:

· Below SMA100 (113,790 KRW), below SMA200 (99,928 KRW): indicating weak long-term trend strength.

[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD histogram trajectory (-2420.0486 → -1879.8924): improving, but weak signal for bearish trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 81,688 KRW): band width at 39.88% suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance at 89,550 KRW: breakthrough could lead to short-term rebound.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Sideways): 5-day low 85,990 KRW, 20-day low 85,670 KRW.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.82x): indicating subdued confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Potential accumulation phase): entry contingent on support confirmation, maintaining wait-and-see.
